productivityTips.title: Use the two-minute rule
productivityTips.description: If a task takes less than two minutes, do it immediately. It clears mental clutter and prevents small tasks from piling up.

productivityTips.title: Time-block your calendar
productivityTips.description: Assign specific hours to specific tasks. It replaces vague to-do lists with concrete commitments and defends deep work

productivityTips.title: Follow the 90/20 rule
productivityTips.description: Work in 90-minutes focused sprints, then take a 20-minute break. It aligns with the body's natural ultradian rhythm

productivityTips.title: Write tomorrow's top 3 tonight
productivityTips.description: Deciding priorities in advance removes morning friction and makes it easier to start oon real work instead of email.

productivityTips.title: Try the Pomodoro Technique
productivityTips.description: Work for 25 minutes, break for 5. After four cycles, take a longer  break. It creates urgency and prevents burnout.
